fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The Game Steward’s direct product photo at https://www.thegamesteward.com/products/mint-delivery identifies the original Five24 Labs Kickstarter tin. The 2017 creator campaign https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/poketto/mint-delivery-the-minty-fresh-pick-up-and-deliver confirms the tin-format edition used by the cited English rules. Reduced to 360 × 229 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player with the freshest breath starts.
clarifications: That player takes the Starting Player token; all players receive an equal number of turns.

This finished sheet supersedes the archived booklet with unfinished placeholders and matches inventory BGG 230251. SHA-256: d638e1d8dc84653cfc6edefe8b1fea7b095f282d3b0442558d3d4c38fa72a542. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The rules give no objective test or tie procedure for freshest breath.
